propositions: On primary LLM exhaustion, banked criterion verdicts are retained and recovered incrementally over batched successor runs (not per-criterion fan-out), resuming with only unverified criteria.
The primary run records criterion verdicts incrementally to a run-scoped bank keyed by deterministic ID (c<index>-<sha256>), with evidence capped at 3,000 chars and truncation flagged.

Successor batches are sized by resolved model class (trivial/standard/frontier → 8/8/12 criteria cap) and allocated a budget pool of completion_recovery_pool_multiplier × ceil(verify_step_floor(c)/2), with per-run allocation floor(pool/runs_remaining).
The criteria-scaled step floor verify_step_floor(c)=clamp(8×c, 48, 480) replaces the flat 480, reducing excess budget that triggers runaway guards on low-criteria tickets.

Read-file memo is normalized by path: first read of a path caches whole-file content; subsequent reads at any line range are served from cache, collapsing re-read waste measured at 77% in prior diagnostics.

A full-coverage verdict is always emitted when any criteria are banked; unverified criteria appear as met=false placeholders; if LLM finalizer fails twice, a deterministic no-LLM fallback assembles the verdict with certifiable=false and finalizer=deterministic_fallback, never verdict-less.
